spec_match.rationale: Replays real focus-steal scenarios in real iframes and reloads them with real allow attributes when the policy is toggled — the exact contract the directive governs.

interactive.rationale: Enable-policy and reset controls drive real iframe reloads and a timestamped event log recorded 'sandwich-b-deny stole focus' during the driven run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised credential-overlay, polled-poll, and ad-iframe focus-steal replays.

edge_cases.rationale: Three distinct attack shapes plus the policy-on counterpart cover both the exploit and the mitigation branch.

references.rationale: Links the Permissions Policy spec but omits the chromestatus.com/feature/5179186249465856 self-heal link required by invariant 3.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 5 pass / 1 fail in this Chromium 141 session.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: toggled the policy, iframes reloaded and the live log recorded steal/ready events; zero console errors, no failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Only injected page-level telemetry.js; no per-demo assert telemetry.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons and inputs carry labels (6 aria/label hits), but the attack log updates without an aria-live region.

openQuestions.title: Add the ChromeStatus reference link
openQuestions.detail: The references block cites the spec but not chromestatus.com/feature/5179186249465856 — invariant 3 requires the self-heal link on every page.

openQuestions.title: Make the steal log a live region
openQuestions.detail: The timestamped focus-steal log is the core evidence surface of this demo; aria-live=polite on it would let non-visual users follow the replay.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: clicked 'Enable policy', watched real iframes reload and the log record 'sandwich-b-deny stole focus' plus per-frame ready events; zero console errors; conformance panel honestly 5 pass / 1 fail.
